en: I'll guarantee ya a sweet time, like you'll never forget. See ya around.
Hey! I know that face. You're that taxi driver. Suzuki, right? I hear you've been pickin' fights with us Devil Killers.
Man, if I had the time I'd kick yer ass in a race right now! But I don't. Guess I'll jus' have t'kick yer ass the old-fashioned way!
Gah! You just won't go down. But I'll get ya, you'll see!
Hey, gramps, hand over your money! I'm with the Devil Killers, so don't go gettin' any big ideas about fightin' back.
You listenin'!? Fork over the money, ya old fuck!
Seriously!? Fuck this.
Found ya, Suzuki-san! You're that taxi driver who thinks he can take on the Devil Killers, ain'tcha?
Hehehe. We eat chumps like you for breakfast! Ya better stop stickin' yer neck out, or it's gonna get chopped off!
Ack! Alright, I've had enough. I won't be hasslin' you again!
You're the taxi driver who's been challenging the Devil Killers, aren't ya?
You gone and pissed off the wrong guys, pal. Time t'die!
Okay, you win. Just stop, please. Ya got me, alright?
You that Suzuki guy? The taxi driver tryin' to take on the Devil Killers? Ya cheeky fuck...
It's 'bout time you learned to fear the Killers!
No way... You're tougher than nails!
You handed over a <Color:8>Beef Rice Lunch Set (L)<Color:Default>.
You got <Color:8>1,000 yen<Color:Default>.
Oh wow, I've never been to a store like this before!
Really? I thought lots of young people had brand-name bags like these.
Yeah, but I'm not into brands all that much. I only care if I like the design or not.
But I'm sure there's a design you'd like among the branded merchandise.
I guess, but wouldn't that be a little expensive?
And carrying around a bag just because it's got a logo on it seems a bit braggy. I'd be embarrassed to carry that sort of thing around.
It's a little expensive, sure. Even though they're high quality, the price makes you think twice about buying it.
Right. And it really doesn't cost that much to make it, so don't you think it's a total rip-off?
Advertising and labor do cost money, after all. But they probably make it more expensive to create its value.
What do you mean by that?
Well, by making the price higher they're limiting the number of people who can buy it, right?
If they set the price lower then anyone could buy it. It would lose its exclusivity.
Makes sense. If it were cheaper, I'd probably buy it too. And then it wouldn't really be bragging.
Right. Brand merchandise isn't just about design, but also whether or not there's any sort of status that comes with it.
It's important to be noticed. You can't let yourself be satisfied with something just because you happen to like it.
But isn't it tacky to buy a particular brand just to get people to notice you?
Is it?
Yes! Liking something is all well and fine, but buying something to make other people jealous is really tacky.
You have a point. Obsessing over products without understanding their real value could be a bad trait in Japanese culture.
At any rate, I think people who are into that stuff aren't really my type.
Still, it might be worth owning at least one designer label item. You might develop an appreciation for it.
It's not just about design. A famous brand represents both artisans and their craftsmanship.
There's a lot of attention paid to even the smallest of details. You'll see that the product is far superior to comparable items.
But ordinary people won't even be able to tell, right? Either people won't pay attention to it or the difference would be too subtle to notice.
After all, if you need a salesperson to explain the details of a product that you wouldn't otherwise notice, then your average person won't have a clue.
That could be true. But it also gives you something to talk about. Some people may appreciate a person who's knowledgeable about fashion.
That's still kinda lame. What's the point in buying designer label products if you have to educate others about them?
Good point. I guess that's why they slap those big logos on them. To impress people and promote their brand.

Thank you for stopping by. Please come again.
Sir, just between you and me, are you aware of the famous brand outlet located out in the suburbs?
An outlet store? I don't want to go that far just to buy outdated merchandise.
Ah, but this outlet gets new items in as well, including the latest in couture from Paris. And right after they're announced, too!
If you time it right, you can get hot items at that store for only a fraction of the price.
Oh? I wasn't aware of that little trick.
Well, of course you can't get the <Italic>very</Italic> latest items at the outlet. For those fashions, look no further than our store.
(A famous brand outlet store? Maybe I could talk about that at the cabaret club.)

Sir, are you familiar with the concept of edible tea? It's all the rage at tea salons these days.
Edible tea?
Yes. While snacks with black tea mixed in are fairly common, meals prepared with tea are a new trend that is quite popular amongst black tea aficionados.
Oh? What kind of dishes are there?
For example, they boil tea to make tea syrup and steak sauce, which is then served along with the food itself.
This allows you to better appreciate the flavor of black tea incorporated in the dish, rather than simply pairing tea with food.
(Edible tea, huh? Maybe I could talk about it at the cabaret club.)

(Hinata seems to be hungry for some <Color:8>Horumon-yaki<Color:Default>.)
Ooh, this looks yummy!
Hey, don't just eat the meat. Have some vegetables, too.
Oh, I don't need vegetables. You can have them all if you like, Kiryu-san.
Wait, what?
Whenever I'm on a date, the guy always makes me eat whatever I leave on my plate, and I wind up putting on weight.
Don't change the subject. It's bad for your health if you don't eat vegetables.
Nah, I'll be fine. I drink vegetable juice.
You're already eating now, though. If you just eat the vegetables, you won't need to drink the juice later.
Yeah, but I hate vegetables.
Because they taste awful.
You sound like a child. I thought most adults got over their fear of vegetables.
Hey, that's got nothing to do with it! Maybe your taste buds are just off.
You know, I read in the paper that kids these days dislike eggplant more than they do carrots or peppers. Must be a sign of the times.
What? No way! Eggplant is delicious!
Wait, so you'll eat eggplant?
Sure! Stuff like mapo eggplant is the bomb! I love it! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Sounds like it's a matter of seasoning, then. If you add sauce or dressing to the vegetables, you could probably eat all kinds, right?
Don't be wasteful. Being a picky eater is bad manners.
Come on, you must've had foods you didn't like when you were a kid, Kiryu-san. Can't you cut me some slack?
It's got nothing to do with being a kid or not. I didn't have the luxury of complaining about that sort of thing growing up.
I knew how hard people worked to put food on the table for me, so I was just grateful to have anything to eat at all.
Well, geez, when you put it like that.
I feel kinda bad now. I guess I should eat my vegetables once in a while, huh?
Yeah, you probably should.
Then I'm not going to treat you. If you want me to pick up the tab, finish off the plate.
Fine, then I'll pay for it myself. Hey, maybe I can treat you instead, Kiryu-san.
You really don't want to eat it, do you?
I shouldn't have to eat what I don't like. And I get my nutrition from drinking vegetable juice anyways.
Well, I guess that's true.
Right? I don't eat as much as you do, so I don't want to fill myself up with things I don't enjoy.
I don't know about just depending on juice though.
Thanks for the treat!
Here's your check. Thank you very much.
Sorry, something came up all of a sudden. I have to go.
I see. Well, please come again.
(I'm broke.)
Sorry. There's something I need to take care of.
Ah, I see. Please do come again.

(Hinata seems to be hungry for some <Color:8>Akagai<Color:Default>.)
I haven't had dinner at this hour in a really long time.
Oh? But isn't this the usual time for eating dinner?
Well, I only eat one meal a day, is the thing.
Really? And you don't get hungry?
Oh, I get hungry, but I stick it out. It doesn't bother me after a while.
I can't do that. Even if it's a little late, I have to eat three meals a day. And I'll eat until I'm full each time.
You're going to get fat, you know. Even though you're breaking up your eating into meals, you ruin that by eating too much at each sitting.
Is that so?
Well, yeah. Whatever you eat gets turned into energy, so you can easily wind up eating three days worth of food.
That makes sense. Come to think of it, even when I eat until I'm full, I always get hungry around the same time each day.
Everyone has different metabolisms, after all. It's not like you'll die if you don't eat three meals a day.
You really know a lot about this stuff. I'm a little surprised.
So did I give you something to think about? Hey, us girls know a lot about how diets work.
I think you might be a little too thin, actually.
It's worse to eat just one meal. Otherwise, you aren't getting enough nourishment.
Well, I'm eating twice today, so I'll be fine.
Maybe so, but still...
Besides, it doesn't matter if you only eat once or twice a day. It's worse if you change how much you eat.
If you don't have a regular schedule of meals, you're sure to get fat in no time.
In that case, should we not eat here?
Of course not! You ordered it for me, so I'm going to appreciate it fully.
Heh. It's good to forget about the details and just enjoy your meal.
